risk_summary: The company reports worsening losses, operating cash burn, termination of its principal option agreement, and dependence on selling securities or raising additional capital. Although liquidity is presented as sufficient for twelve months, the plan relies on uncertain financing, monetization of investments, and finding new project partners. Repetitive boilerplate, truncated text, and several drafting inconsistencies reduce disclosure clarity.
